title: Aerophone Path
subtitle: A saxophone curriculum on the Aerophone, alto or tenor, to about grade 5 with jazz heads and blues.
benchmark: ABRSM or Trinity Grade 5 saxophone; Rubank Intermediate, Niehaus Basic Jazz Conception Vol. 1

levels.title: First notes, left hand
levels.goal: Play five left-hand notes with steady air and a tongued start on every note. Learn eight first tunes. Rubank and the Roland Lesson app start the same way: B A G, then C, then the right hand.
levels.adds: Written range: G4 to C5, then E4 to C5.

steps.title: Set up the AE-20
steps.setup: Sax mode, alto scene. In the setup check, play a written G4, then your softest and loudest notes. Woodshed's reading key must match the AE-20's transpose: C with Transpose C, Alto Eb with the alto transpose on.
steps.done: Written G4 shows as G4 on screen. The breath trace reaches f without clipping.

levels.title: The blues
levels.goal: Hear and count the 12-bar form. Play the blues scale and minor pentatonic in the two jazz blues keys. They're alto D and G, which are concert F and Bb. Learn four blues heads by memory. Improvise from week one, as Aebersold Vol. 1 does.

levels.title: Breath, dynamics and vibrato, after Teal
levels.goal: Control the dynamic in every register. Shape phrases with planned breaths. Use a Teal-method vibrato, pulses timed to a click, on the long notes of ballads. Here the Aerophone can beat a sax teacher: it measures breath and pulse rate.

levels.title: Grade 5 capstone: Ferling and a recital
levels.goal: Prepare the classical half of the grade: a Ferling slow study with breaths, dynamics and vibrato planned. Play the full scale requirement. Sight-read. Record a three-piece recital, one take each.

steps.title: Pick and import the Ferling
steps.setup: An odd-numbered (slow) study from IMSLP or this level's list. Bring it in with MuseScore PDF import or enter it in MuseScore Studio, then open it in Song practice.
steps.done: The notation imported and checked against the PDF.

steps.title: Plan breaths and dynamics
steps.setup: Mark breaths and hairpins in MuseScore and import the file again. Song practice shows them on the staff. Then play a Performance run with Also score set to Dynamics and breaths.

steps.title: Ferling in chunks
steps.setup: Song practice: loop each 4-bar phrase in Wait mode, then Performance. Another Ferling from this level's list works too, but this step scores No. 23.

steps.title: Ferling whole
steps.setup: Song practice, Performance, at the marked tempo, with Also score set to Dynamics and breaths. Half the score is the notes, half the dynamics and breaths as marked.

steps.title: Scales, the full set
steps.setup: Majors, the three minor forms, chromatic, arpeggios and thirds in 12 keys, at grade 5 speed (66 BPM, four notes a click).

steps.title: Sight-reading
steps.setup: Reading, sight-reading: Level 3, grade 4 to 5 lines.
steps.done: 80% on the first run, on 5 new lines.

steps.title: A solo transcription
steps.setup: Parker's first chorus on Billie's Bounce, or Stitt on Au Privave, learnt from the notation and the recording. Billie's Bounce is scored here.

steps.title: Record the recital
steps.setup: Record: the Ferling, one jazz head with 2 choruses, one pop hit with vibrato, one take each.
steps.done: Three takes kept in the journal.
